findings.reason: A useful expository diagram is warranted: the prose distinguishes iterated strict transforms from multiplicity-bearing scheme-theoretic inverse images. A per-step Cartesian square makes the total-transform operation and strict-transform inclusion explicit without suggesting a geometric crossing over an unspecified field.
findings.action: Added a final Remarks section with a per-step Cartesian square and strict-transform inclusion, plus center/residue-field and terminal SNC explanations.

correction: Added one explanatory tikzcd in final Remarks. Original title, frontmatter, Statement, Facts, and all six proof steps remain byte-identical.

diagram_math_checks.objects: For each existing step pi_i:S_i -> S_(i-1), Z_i is the pullback effective Cartier divisor of Z_(i-1), and T_i is the iterated strict transform of the original reduced Z.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Existing proof step 3.1 and def-total-transform-divisor; def-strict-transform-closed-subscheme defines a closed subscheme of the inverse image.

diagram_math_checks.maps: T_i -> Z_i is a closed inclusion; Z_i -> S_i and Z_(i-1) -> S_(i-1) are closed immersions; Z_i -> Z_(i-1) is the restriction of pi_i.
diagram_math_checks.relations: The right square commutes and is Cartesian by the scheme-theoretic inverse-image identity Z_i=Z_(i-1) x_(S_(i-1)) S_i. The strict transform is not labelled equal to the total transform, and no reducedness of Z_i is asserted.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Existing proof step 3.1 plus the total- and strict-transform definitions; the composite pullback agrees with the original inverse image.

diagram_math_checks.geometry: Each actual chosen center is a closed point on the current support with two-dimensional ambient local ring. E_i is P^1 over kappa(p_(i-1)), not over an assumed common ground field, and contributes to total-transform support.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Existing steps 2.1, 3.1, 4.1 and 5.1; lem-blowup-of-closed-point-of-regular-surface-is-regular claims P^1 only in local dimension two.

diagram_math_checks.terminal_condition: The final reduced support contains regular strict-transform components and regular exceptional strict transforms; at a closed support point one or two components pass, pairwise intersection multiplicity is one when two pass, and no three pass.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Existing steps 4.1–6.1 and def-strict-normal-crossings-divisor. The diagram asserts no smoothness over a field, relative SNC, unique centers, or higher-dimensional theorem.

visual_inspection.result: Final enlarged labels and arrows are legible and separated; no diagram clipping or overlap. Proof text unchanged.
